name: M7.Connectivity.difference_affine
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (A : Finset (ZMod N)) (u : (ZMod N)ˣ) (s : ZMod N), M7.Connectivity.differences (A.image (M7.Action.affine u s)) = (fun x : ZMod N => (u : ZMod N)*x) '' M7.Connectivity.differences A
guidance: Unpack two image members and subtract; distributivity cancels s. Reverse chooses original two support members. Set image, not multiset. Use original exact statement. Return tactic lines without leading by.
